scope: Focused startup and shared metadata persistence repair over the complete 0.16.0 baseline.

focused_backend.scope: Current generated persistence/startup, import/edit/export, six-mode inspection workflow and destination regressions. No native Windows or user-project execution claim.

large_metadata_independent.scope: Generated >20 MB duplicated-patch metadata and real small scan/mask/label caches; production startup/save/open/portable/rollback paths. The user project was unavailable. No Windows/WebView2 execution or 550-million-point benchmark.

checks.name: Production startup opens an empty 0.16.1 workspace after preserving an actual >20 MB legacy autosave
Visible Open restores the previous session with all 45,000 groups, retained points, CAD point and existing edit
Save As commits the oversized restored project through the visible project dialog
New project and visible Open restore the same complete saved grouping result
Complete portable project saves through the actual format and destination controls
Portable project reopens through the actual browser file-import flow without losing groups or edits
Optional startup snapshot failure shows the recovery path in a visible modal and leaves the workspace usable
No uncaught browser JavaScript errors during startup, recovery, project transitions or export
Independent disk, portable archive and raw recovery hashes preserve clusters, original coordinates, masks, IDs, labels and explicit saved snapshot

actual_browser.scope: Actual Chromium with production localhost API, generated 20 MB-plus clustering metadata and Linux software WebGL. No native Windows/WebView2 or user-project execution.

timing_observations.source: Production job_status.json snapshots read during this same browser run; intervals are backend jobs, not complete UI timings.
timing_observations.list_and_refresh: Not separately instrumented. Large-group project transitions and UI refreshes were observed to take tens of seconds on this shared host.
timing_observations.limitation: This is a correctness/recovery gate, not a controlled performance benchmark, SMRG speed improvement or UI responsiveness claim.

earlier_attempts.reason: Sandbox denied localhost socket creation before browser execution; rerun with authorized loopback access.

Generated backend-only CAD record lacked required production revision/layer/geometry fields. Test fixture completed using cad_api.empty/object_record and cad_geometry.build; no production fix was required.

installer_transactions.scope: Installer activation checks on Linux. Includes complete preservation and backup of a >20 MB existing project.json, rejection of nonisolated/existing self-check workspaces, and activation refusal on startup-check failure. No native Windows runtime claim.

isolated_startup_self_check.fixture_data: Synthetic metadata only; no scan points or user project paths.
isolated_startup_self_check.scope: The same oversized-metadata self-check body used before installer activation, executed on Linux with the matching dependency runtime. Native Windows execution occurs when the installer runs on Windows.

old_version_reproduction.scope: Frozen packaged 0.16.0 source baseline; generated valid duplicated cluster metadata exceeding20,000,000bytes, not the user project.
old_version_reproduction.exception: ValueError: Project metadata exceeds the supported 20 MB manifest size. The previous saved snapshot is unchanged.

limitations: Actual user project and desktop_error.txt were not attached.
Generated 26.6 MB metadata fixture is not a 550-million-point workload.
No native Windows/WebView2/GPU execution on the build host.
